en.shortDescription: Open-source backend in a single executable
en.longDescription:
PocketBase is an open-source backend-as-a-service with realtime database, auth, and file storage in one container.

Create the admin account at /_/ on first launch.

de.shortDescription: Open-Source-Backend in einer einzigen ausführbaren Datei
de.longDescription:
PocketBase ist ein Open-Source-Backend-as-a-Service mit Echtzeit-Datenbank, Auth und Dateispeicherung in einem Container.

Erstelle das Admin-Konto beim ersten Start unter /_/.

fr.shortDescription: Backend open source dans un seul exécutable
fr.longDescription:
PocketBase est un backend-as-a-service open source avec base de données temps réel, authentification et stockage de fichiers dans un seul conteneur.

Créez le compte admin sur /_/ au premier lancement.

pt.shortDescription: Backend open-source em um único executável
pt.longDescription:
PocketBase é um backend-as-a-service open-source com banco de dados em tempo real, autenticação e armazenamento de arquivos em um único contêiner.

Crie a conta de admin em /_/ no primeiro acesso.
